editorial.blurb: La Licor Panamericana is a hidden gem offering an authentic culinary journey through the Americas with meticulously crafted cocktails and passionate cooking from Chef Carlos.
editorial.insiderTip: Book a reservation after 6:30pm when the restaurant fills up; arrive for happy hour Wed-Sun 4pm-6:30pm for $10 cocktail specials, and request the full tasting tour to experience dishes from different countries as the chef intended.
